grammar.label: wish and if only + past perfect

explanation.en: For a present regret use the past ('I wish I lived here'); for a past regret go one step further back ('I wish I had said something').
explanation.uz: Hozirgi afsus uchun o'tgan zamon ('I wish I lived here'); o'tmishdagi afsus uchun bir pog'ona orqaga ('I wish I had said something').

grammar.positive_example: I wish I had taken that job.
grammar.negative_example: I wish I took that job last year.

l1_notes.uz: 'Koshki aytganimda' — o'zbekchada bitta shakl; ingliz tilida hozirgi va o'tmish afsusi ikki xil.

grammar.label: past perfect continuous
grammar.meaning: an activity that had been going on before a past moment

explanation.en: Use 'had been + -ing' for how long something had gone on before another past event: 'She had been waiting for an hour when he arrived.'
explanation.uz: Boshqa o'tgan voqeadan oldin ish qancha davom etganini bildirish uchun 'had been + -ing': 'She had been waiting for an hour when he arrived.'

grammar.positive_example: He was tired because he had been driving all night.
grammar.negative_example: He was tired because he was driving all night before.

l1_notes.uz: Uch qismli shakl (had + been + -ing) o'zbek tilida yo'q; qisqartirish keng tarqalgan.
